table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Icode=code1, 
	code2, 
	custcode=code3, 
	Item=name1, 
	Customer=name2, 
	GroupName=name3, 
	AliasName=name4, 
	PackingDesc=name5, 
	Price=value1, 
	OpQty=value2, 
	OpVal=Value3, 
	PurQty=value4, 
	PurVal=value5, 
	PrQty=Value6, 
	PrVal=Value7, 
	SaleQty=Value8, 
	SaleVal=Value9, 
	SRQty=Value10, 
	SRVal=Value11, 
	OtherQty=Value12, 
	OtherVal=Value13
FROM ReportData
ORDER BY Customer, GroupName, Item
table.sort: groupname A, item A, aliasname A, packingdesc A, price A, opqty A, opval A, purqty A, purval A, prqty A, prval A, srqty A, srval A, otherqty A, otherval A
